title: Bachmann N Scale C&O Box Car #23000 Insulated Cushion Underframe
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Freight Cars
descriptionText:
Bachmann N scale 50' single-door box car, Chesapeake & Ohio (C&O), road number 23000. Lettered "Insulated Cushion Underframe," DF-B door, "C&O for Progress" herald. Capacity 120000, Load Limit 127000, Light Wt 42500, built 5-48.
Used, no visible damage noted — please review photos closely. Ships well-packed.
